title: DevOps in Power Platform
deckTitle: Managed Operations: Build, Deploy and Operate at Enterprise Scale
summary: ALM shifts from moving Dataverse solutions between environments to moving Git-backed project commits through dev/test/prod stages, with built-in approvals and much faster operational alerting through Monitor.
whyItMatters: The most actionable session for delivery teams: agentic development has outpaced review capacity, so Microsoft is investing in Git-backed ALM, deployment approvals, and Monitor.

keyPoints.heading: Generally available
keyPoints.text: Power Platform Pipelines, default pipelines per environment group, native Git integration (GitHub now in preview alongside Azure DevOps), and Monitor.

keyPoints.heading: Customer spotlight
keyPoints.text: Lummus Technology: 4 people managing 50 projects. Agents assist dev/test/review, engineers approve; deployments auto-draft release notes, training videos (Playwright), and SharePoint pages for owner review; App Insights + agent-proposed fixes.

keyPoints.heading: Project = Repo
keyPoints.text: A project is one Git repo that builds and deploys as a unit; one directory per component with ms.project.config.json at root and ms.config.json per app. Apps only for now; agents and data later.

keyPoints.heading: Stages
keyPoints.text: Dev (every commit runnable, authors only), Test (optional, invited audience), Prod (single live deployment).

keyPoints.heading: Single-environment ALM by default
keyPoints.text: ~80% of apps keep all stages in the maker's personal environment, ~15% in a shared team environment, ~5% need multi-environment ALM (preview end of year).

keyPoints.heading: Config overrides
keyPoints.text: Per-target override files (e.g., ms.prod.config.json); project variables replace environment variables; connection references overridable per component.

keyPoints.heading: Repos
keyPoints.text: Out-of-the-box repos by default; GitHub Enterprise native integration (Microsoft Managed Apps GitHub App); bring-your-own Git with service principal auth.

keyPoints.heading: Approvals
keyPoints.text: Roles: Project Owner, Contributor or Agent, Approver. Approve via CLI, email, or in-product portal; works with agentic tools via skills; service principals supported.

keyPoints.heading: Monitor
keyPoints.text: Alerts evaluated hourly instead of daily; 'When an alert fires' trigger (Power Platform for Admins V2) routes alerts to Teams / Azure DevOps; export beyond 30-day retention via REST API / PAC CLI in OpenTelemetry format; Power Pages site metrics.

keyPoints.heading: Autonomous ops demo
keyPoints.text: Alert webhook creates a GitHub issue; GitHub Actions start agents that inspect the commit, propose and test a fix, then deploy.
